summary: Turner's February 2025 statement frames the war as ignited by Hamas on October 7, calls for US action to ensure Gaza peace while addressing security of both Israelis and Palestinians, and cites Iran-backed threats. In May 2024 he voted Yea for H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of the IHRA definition in federal education-discrimination enforcement.
